description: This PHP file defines a custom form type 'MediaType' for use with the Symfony framework. It extends the AbstractType class and customizes form building, options configuration, and form view rendering related to media input, such as videos or media URLs.

classes.name: MediaType
classes.description: A custom form type for handling media URL inputs, extending Symfony's AbstractType. It adds behaviors for setting default URL protocols, configuring form rendering options, and customizing the form view.

methods.name: buildForm
methods.description: Configures the form by adding an event subscriber to fix URL protocol if a default protocol is specified.

methods.name: configureOptions
methods.description: Sets default options for the form, including CSS classes and default protocol, and enforces allowed types for options.

methods.name: buildView
methods.description: Adjusts the form view variables for rendering, setting CSS classes and attributes based on options.

methods.name: getBlockPrefix
methods.description: Returns the prefix used for form block naming, here 'media'.

methods.name: getParent
methods.description: Specifies the parent form type, which is TextType.
